text: RIght, so i would, because there is going to be the time where i might come and add a new one, you need to store the individual and then we end up having a some sort of compile button approach that will take them and piece together so we can always keep adding more without it assuming its the final product
resolution: Preserved every individual base and variant PNG/mesh as editable source of truth and added an explicit Compile/Recompile Shared Atlas control with progress, result metrics, and fresh/stale status. Adding or updating a look marks the derived atlas stale without silently recompiling or destroying the previous output.
